title: How to Use Posting Groups in Business Central (2025)

chapters.title: Demo: Sales Invoice and Posting Groups

features.name: Posting Groups
features.description: Core accounting feature that links customers, vendors, and items with GL accounts. Posting groups include general business posting groups, product posting groups, customer posting groups, vendor posting groups, and VAT/tax posting groups.

features.name: Business Posting Groups
features.description: Posting groups that focus on who you do business with, such as grouping master data based on domestic, foreign, or other customer/vendor classifications.

features.name: Product Posting Groups
features.description: Posting groups that focus on what you buy or sell, allowing you to group items around resale, manufacture, or retail categories.

features.name: Customer Posting Groups
features.description: Posting groups assigned to customers that contain receivable accounts where customer receivable amounts will be posted in the general ledger.

features.name: Inventory Posting Groups
features.description: Posting groups assigned to items that contain inventory accounts where item inventory amounts will be posted in the general ledger.

features.name: VAT Posting Setup
features.description: Posting setup that determines which VAT accounts are used when posting transactions with different VAT rates, showing VAT rate and base amounts.

features.name: Posting Preview
features.description: Feature that allows users to preview ledger entries that will be created when posting documents, showing subleddger and general ledger entries before actual posting.

features.name: Direct GL Posting
features.description: Ability to post directly to GL accounts without using subleddgers on journal lines and documents, with optional enabling of direct posting for specific accounts.
caveats: requires direct posting to be enabled on the GL account

features.name: Where Used List
features.description: Feature that shows which posting groups use a specific GL account, helping users understand the impact of changes to account configurations.
